title: Doozy Vape Co Infinity Blue Razz Mojito Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Blue Razz Mojito by Doozy Infinity fuses tangy Blue Raspberry with the unmistakable zesty freshness of a sophisticated Mojito cocktail. The vibrant Blue Raspberry brings a sweet-sour burst up front, balanced by a zingy streak of Lime and a touch of herbal Mint, capturing the bright, refreshing spirit of a classic Mojito. A smooth wave of cool Ice on the exhale adds clarity and keeps the flavour sharp and beautifully defined from start to finish. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this Nicotine Salt e-liquid is perfect for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping in refillable vape pod kits , vape pens and compact starter devices . The nic salt formulation delivers fast-acting nicotine relief with a smooth, comfortable throat hit, especially suited to those seeking a satisfying yet discreet vape. Available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg strengths, the Doozy Infinity Nic Salt range continues Doozy Vape Co.’s reputation for crafting imaginative, layered flavours for everyday vapers.
